propositions: Detached pytest runs via nohup report test failures that do not reproduce in foreground runs, causing false regressions to be investigated and signal erosion when real defects are dismissed.

External actors concurrently mutating the shared checkout (file creation, git operations, process reaps) during a detached suite run are misattributed by isolation guards to innocent tests in teardown, producing spurious errors without naming the actual cause.
The _no_repo_root_leaks guard cannot distinguish external top-level mutations from test leaks and silently deletes files it finds, destroying concurrent operations from other agents.
Browser e2e test failures from signal-killed child processes report empty stderr and never inspect returncode, making externally-reaped runs indistinguishable from genuine product regressions.

Detached suites are not inherently untrustworthy; the appearance of detachment-specific failures is entirely due to concurrent external mutation being structurally possible only when the suite runs detached and the agent continues working.

Guard diagnostic messages must distinguish test-caused mutations from external-actor mutations to prevent erosion of the test signal, and child process diagnostics must report returncode to reveal signal-killed children.
